# All Drugs Used in the Analysis and their Class
```{r}
#| label: drug_list
#| include: true
#| echo: false

drugs <- read.csv(drugs_file) %>%
    select(Drug, Category) %>%
    arrange(Category, Drug)

knitr::kable(
    drugs,
    caption = "List of Drugs and their class"
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(font_size = 12)

drugs_list <- drugs$Drug

```

```{r}
#| label: Functions
#| include: false
#| echo: false

# Extract Indications

extract_indications <- function(drug){
  indications <- drug_indications %>% 
  filter(Drug == drug)

  return(indications)
}

# Extract Chosen openGWAS Outcomes

extract_chosen_openGWAS_outcomes <- function(drug){
  
  studies <- grep(paste0("/", drug, "_"), chosen_openGWAS_files, value = T)
  
  if (length(studies) == 0){
    return(NULL)
  } else{
    
    studies <- studies %>% 
      fread()
    
    outcome_ids <- paste0("^", paste(unique(studies$opengwas_id), collapse = "$|^"), "$")
    
    return(list(openGWAS_studies = studies, outcome_ids = outcome_ids))
  }
}

# Extract Drug Targets

extract_targets <- function(drug){
  targets <- drug_targets %>%
    filter(Drug == gsub("_", " ", drug)) %>%
    select(c("Target", "Gene_Name", "Action", "Direction")) %>%
    unique()
  
  target_list <- paste0("^", paste(targets$Gene_Name, collapse = "$|^"), "$")
  
  if (nrow(targets) == 0){
    return(NULL)
  } else{
    return(list(targets = targets, target_list = target_list))
  }
}

# Extract MR Results for Primary Indications

extract_MR_result <- function(drug, outcome_ids){
  mr_res_all <- grep(paste0("/", drug, "_"), MR_res_files, value = T)
  
  if(length(mr_res_all) == 0){
    return(NULL)
  } else{
    
    mr_res_all <- mr_res_all %>%
      fread()
    
    mr_res <- mr_res_all[grep(outcome_ids, mr_res_all$id.outcome),] %>%
      as.data.frame()
  
  return(mr_res)
  }
}

# Create Plot Data Frame for Primary Indications

create_plot_df <- function(mr_res){
  
  # Adjust p values for multiple testing (per outcome)
  mr_res <- mr_res %>%
    group_by(openGWAS_outcome) %>%
    mutate(pval_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Align direction of effect to the direction of drug effect on the target
  for(g in unique(mr_res$gene.exposure)){
    drug_direction <- mr_res[which(mr_res$gene.exposure == g), "Direction"] %>%
      unique()
    if(drug_direction == "negative"){
      mr_res[which(mr_res$gene.exposure == g), "b"] <- -1 * mr_res[which(mr_res$gene.exposure == g), "b"]
    }
  }
  
  # Converting to Odds ratio (as are all binary outcomes) and adding CIs
  plot_df <- mr_res %>%
    mutate(
      OR = exp(b),
      lower = exp(b - 1.96 * se),
      upper = exp(b + 1.96 * se),
      outcome = factor(openGWAS_outcome),
      sig = pval_adj < 0.05
    )
  
  # Creating a gene(SNP) column
  plot_df$gene.snp <- paste0(plot_df$gene.exposure, "(", plot_df$SNP, ")")
  
    # Assigning a unique colour to each gene(SNP)
  snps <- unique(plot_df$gene.snp)
  
  gene_cols <- setNames(
    scales::hue_pal()(length(snps)),
    snps
  )
  
  # Only fill significant points
  plot_df$fill_col <- ifelse(
    plot_df$sig,
    gene_cols[plot_df$gene.snp],
    "white"
  )
  
  # Individual plot for each target gene
  genes <- unique(plot_df$gene.exposure)

  return(list(plot_df = plot_df, snps = snps, gene_cols = gene_cols, genes = genes))
}

# Plot MR Results for Primary Indications

create_plot <- function(plot_df, g, snps, gene_cols){
      
  df <- subset(plot_df, gene.exposure == g)
    
  # If the drug is an inhibitor of the target, the plot will show decrease in exposure
  effect_direction <- df$Direction %>%
    unique()
    
  if (effect_direction == "negative"){
    x_label <- "Odds Ratio per 1 SD decrease in QTL"
  } else {
    x_label <- "Odds Ratio per 1 SD increase in QTL"
  }
    
    # Plot
  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      y = id.exposure,
      x = OR,
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper
      )
    ) +
      
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(colour = gene.snp), 
      width = 0.2,
      orientation = "y"
    ) +
      
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = gene.snp),
      shape = 21,
      fill = df$fill_col,
      size = 2
    ) +
      
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 1,
      linetype = 2
    ) +
      
    scale_x_log10() +
      
    facet_wrap(
      ~openGWAS_outcome,
      scales = "free_x",
      ncol = 2
    ) +
      
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = gene_cols
    ) +
      
    theme_bw() +
      
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
      
    labs(
      title = g,
      x = x_label,
      y = "Drug Target Measure",
      colour = "Drug Target Measure"
    )

  return(p)
}

# Extract Instruments with a significant effect on an indication

extract_sig_SNP <- function(drug, openGWAS_studies){
  
  # Extract harmonised exposure-outcome data
  harmonised_data <- grep(paste0("/", drug, "_"), harmonised_files, value = T) %>%
    fread() %>%
    filter(id.outcome %in% unique(openGWAS_studies$opengwas_id)) %>%
    left_join(., openGWAS_studies, by = c("id.outcome" = "opengwas_id"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    select(exposure, SNP, beta.exposure, beta.outcome, pval.exposure, pval.outcome, indication, originalname.outcome, gene.exposure, f, r2, Action, Direction)
  
  # Adjust pvalue for multiple testing (per outcome)
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    group_by(originalname.outcome) %>%
    mutate(
      pval.outcome_adj = p.adjust(pval.outcome, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
    
  # Filtering for those with a significant effect on outcome
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    mutate(
      sig = pval.outcome_adj < 0.05
    ) %>%
    filter(sig == TRUE)
  
  # Assigning risk due to drug target effect
  harmonised_data$Risk <- ifelse(
    harmonised_data$beta.outcome < 0,
    "Decreased Risk",
    "Increased Risk"
  )
  
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    mutate(
        exposure_snp = paste(exposure, SNP)
    )
  
  # Save
  
  if(nrow(harmonised_data) != 0) {

    return(list(harmonised_data = harmonised_data, instruments = unique(harmonised_data$exposure_snp)))

  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# Extract MR PREG Results

extract_MR_PREG_results <- function(drug){

  # Read in MR results
  mr_preg_res <- MR_PREG_res_files[grep(paste0("/", gsub(" ", "_", drug), "_"), MR_PREG_res_files)] %>% 
  fread()

  # Add MR PREG full outcome names
  mr_preg_res <- left_join(mr_preg_res, MR_PREG_outcome_names, by = c("id.outcome" = "MR_PREG_Outcome"))

  return(mr_preg_res)
}

# Create Plot Data Frame for MR PREG Results

create_mr_preg_plot_df <- function(mr_preg_res){

  # Add binary outcome column
  mr_preg_res$binary <- ifelse(!is.na(mr_preg_res$ncase.outcome), "Yes", "No")

  # Adjust p values for multiple testing (per outcome)
  mr_preg_res <- mr_preg_res %>%
    group_by(id.outcome) %>%
    mutate(pval_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Filter for significant results
    mr_preg_res <- mr_preg_res %>%
        filter(pval_adj < 0.05)

  # Align direction of effect to the direction of drug effect on the target
  for(g in unique(mr_preg_res$gene.exposure)){
    drug_direction <- mr_preg_res[which(mr_preg_res$gene.exposure == g), "Direction"] %>%
      unique()
    if(drug_direction == "negative"){
      mr_preg_res[which(mr_preg_res$gene.exposure == g), "b"] <- -1 * mr_preg_res[which(mr_preg_res$gene.exposure == g), "b"]
    }
  }

  plot_df <- mr_preg_res %>%
    mutate(
      OR = if_else(binary == "Yes", exp(b), NA_real_),
      lower = if_else(binary == "Yes",
                      exp(b - 1.96 * se),
                      b - 1.96 * se),
      upper = if_else(binary == "Yes",
                      exp(b + 1.96 * se),
                      b + 1.96 * se),
      outcome = factor(Meaning),
      sig = pval < 0.05
    )

  plot_df$gene.snp <- paste0(
    plot_df$gene.exposure,
    "(",
    plot_df$SNP,
    ")"
  )

  snps <- unique(plot_df$gene.snp)

  gene_cols <- setNames(
    scales::hue_pal()(length(snps)),
    snps
  )

  plot_df$fill_col <- ifelse(
    plot_df$sig,
    gene_cols[plot_df$gene.snp],
    "white"
  )

  genes <- unique(plot_df$gene.exposure)

  return(list(plot_df = plot_df, snps = snps, gene_cols = gene_cols, genes = genes))
}

# Plot MR PREG Results for Binary Outcomes

create_bin_plot <- function(plot_df_bin, g, snps, gene_cols){

  df <- subset(plot_df_bin, gene.exposure == g)

  # If the drug is an inhibitor of the target, the plot will show decrease in exposure
  effect_direction <- df$Direction %>%
    unique()
    
  if (effect_direction == "negative"){
    x_label <- "Odds Ratio per 1 SD decrease in QTL"
  } else {
    x_label <- "Odds Ratio per 1 SD increase in QTL"
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      y = id.exposure,
      x = OR,
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper
    )
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(colour = gene.snp), width = 0.2, orientation = "y") +

  geom_point(
    aes(colour = gene.snp),
    shape = 21,
    fill = df$fill_col,
    size = 2
  ) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +

  scale_x_log10() +

  facet_wrap(~ outcome, 
            scales = "free_x", 
            ncol = 2) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values = gene_cols) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = g,
    x = x_label, 
    y = "Drug Target Measure", 
    colour = "Drug Target Variant")
  
  return(p)
}

# Plot MR PREG Results for Continuous Outcomes

create_cont_plot <- function(plot_df_cont, g, snps, gene_cols){

  df <- subset(plot_df_cont, gene.exposure == g)

  # If the drug is an inhibitor of the target, the plot will show decrease in exposure
  effect_direction <- df$Direction %>%
    unique()
    
  if (effect_direction == "negative"){
    x_label <- "Effect Size per 1 SD decrease in QTL"
  } else {
    x_label <- "Effect Size per 1 SD increase in QTL"
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      y = id.exposure,
      x = b,
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper
    )
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(colour = gene.snp), width = 0.2, orientation = "y") +

  geom_point(
    aes(colour = gene.snp),
    shape = 21,
    fill = df$fill_col,
    size = 2
  ) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +

  facet_wrap(~ outcome, 
            scales = "free_x",

  scale_colour_manual(values = gene_cols) +

  ) +

  labs(
    title = g,
    x = x_label, 
    y = "Drug Target Measure", 
    colour = "Drug Target Variant")

  return(p)

}

# Extract SNPs with a significant effect on an MR PREG outcome

extract_mr_preg_sig_SNP <- function(drug){

  # Extract harmonised exposure-outcome data
  harmonised_data <- grep(paste0("/",gsub(" ", "_", drug), "_"), MR_PREG_harmonised_files, value = TRUE) %>%
    fread() %>%
    select(exposure, SNP, beta.exposure, beta.outcome, pval.exposure, pval.outcome, id.outcome, gene.exposure, f, r2, Action, Direction)

  harmonised_data <- left_join(harmonised_data, MR_PREG_outcome_names, by = c("id.outcome" = "MR_PREG_Outcome"))

  # Adjust p values for multiple testing (per outcome)
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    group_by(id.outcome) %>%
    mutate(
      pval.outcome_adj = p.adjust(pval.outcome, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Filter for significant SNP-outcome associations
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    mutate(
      sig = pval.outcome_adj < 0.05
    ) %>%
    filter(sig == TRUE) %>%
    unique()

  # Assigning risk due to drug target effect
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    mutate(
      Risk = ifelse(
        beta.outcome < 0, 
        "Decreased Risk", 
        "Increased Risk")
    )

  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data[order(harmonised_data$id.outcome, harmonised_data$SNP, harmonised_data$Risk),]

  if(nrow(harmonised_data) != 0) {
    
    return(harmonised_data)

  } else {
  return(NULL)
  }
}

# Create a table of significant SNP-outcome associations for those that are associated with primary indication and MR PREG outcomes

sig_results_table <- function(sig_results, mr_preg_sig_results){

  if(!is.null(sig_results) & !is.null(mr_preg_sig_results)){

    sig_results_table <- sig_results$harmonised_data %>%
      select(exposure, SNP, indication, originalname.outcome, Action, Risk) %>%
      left_join(., mr_preg_sig_results %>% select(exposure, Meaning, Risk), by = "exposure", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
      arrange(Meaning, Risk.x, exposure, SNP, indication)

    return(sig_results_table)

  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

```


```{r}
#| label: Results
#| include: true
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false

for (drug in drugs_list) {

  cat("\n\n# ", drug, "\n\n", sep = "")

  drug <- gsub(" ", "_", drug)

  # Primary Indications

  cat("\n\n## ", "Primary Indications", "\n\n", sep = "")

  indications <- extract_indications(drug)

  if (nrow(indications) == 0) {
  cat("No indications found for ", drug)
  next
  } else{
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(knitr::kable(
      indications,
      caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "Primary Indications"))%>%
          kable_styling(font_size = 14),
      sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
  }

  # Chosen openGWAS Outcome

  cat("\n\n## ", "Chosen openGWAS Outcome", "\n\n", sep = "")

  openGWAS_studies <- extract_chosen_openGWAS_outcomes(drug)

  if(is.null(openGWAS_studies)){
  cat("No chosen openGWAS outcomes found for ", drug)
  next
  } else{
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(knitr::kable(
      openGWAS_studies$openGWAS_studies,
      caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "Chosen OpenGWAS Outcomes"))%>%
          kable_styling(font_size = 14), 
      sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
  }

  # Drug Targets

  cat("\n\n## ", "Drug Targets", "\n\n", sep = "")

  targets <- extract_targets(drug)

  if(is.null(targets)){
  cat("No targets found for ", drug)
  next
  } else{
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(knitr::kable(
      targets$targets,
      caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "Targets")) %>%
          kable_styling(font_size = 14), 
      sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
  }

  # MR Results for Primary Indications

  cat("\n\n## ", "MR Results for Primary Indications", "\n\n", sep = "")

  mr_res <- extract_MR_result(drug, openGWAS_studies$outcome_ids)

  if(is.null(mr_res)){
  cat("No MR results found for ", drug)
  next
  }

  plot_df <- create_plot_df(mr_res)

  # Create plots for each target gene

  for(g in plot_df$genes){

  p <- create_plot(plot_df$plot_df, g, plot_df$snps, plot_df$gene_cols)

  suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(print(p)))

  }

  # Extract SNPs with a significant effect on an indication

  sig_results <- extract_sig_SNP(drug, openGWAS_studies$openGWAS_studies)

  # Only continue if not Null

  if(is.null(sig_results)){
  cat("No significant SNP-outcome associations found for ", drug)
  next
  }

  # MR Results for MR PREG Outcomes

  cat("\n\n## ", "MR Results for MR PREG Outcomes", "\n\n", sep = "")

  mr_preg_res <- extract_MR_PREG_results(drug)

  # Only plotting significant MR PREG results

  mr_preg_plot_df <- create_mr_preg_plot_df(mr_preg_res)

  # Plotting MR PREG results for instruments with a protective effect on indications (those that decrease risk of indication)
  
  cat("\n\n### ", "Protective Instruments", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # Results for protective instruments (those that decrease risk of indication)

  prot_snps <- sig_results$harmonised_data %>%
      filter(Risk == "Decreased Risk") %>%
      select(exposure, SNP)

  if(nrow(prot_snps) != 0){

    mr_preg_plot_df_prot <- mr_preg_plot_df$plot_df %>%
      semi_join(prot_snps, by = c("SNP", "id.exposure" = "exposure"))

    cat("\n\n", "Binary Outcomes", "\n\n", sep = "")

    # Binary Outcomes

    mr_preg_plot_df_prot_bin <- mr_preg_plot_df_prot %>% 
      filter(binary == "Yes")

    if(nrow(mr_preg_plot_df_prot_bin) == 0){

    cat("No significant binary MR PREG results found for ", drug)

    } else{
      for (g in mr_preg_plot_df$genes)  {

      p <- create_bin_plot(mr_preg_plot_df_prot_bin, g, mr_preg_plot_df$snps, mr_preg_plot_df$gene_cols)

      suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(print(p)))

      }
    }

    cat("\n\n", "Continuous Outcomes", "\n\n", sep = "")

    # Continuous Outcomes

    mr_preg_plot_df_prot_cont <- mr_preg_plot_df_prot %>% 
      filter(binary == "No")

    if(nrow(mr_preg_plot_df_prot_cont) == 0){

      cat("No significant continuous MR PREG results found for ", drug)
      
    } else{
      for (g in mr_preg_plot_df$genes)  {

      p <- create_cont_plot(mr_preg_plot_df_prot_cont, g, mr_preg_plot_df$snps, mr_preg_plot_df$gene_cols)

      suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(print(p)))

      }
    }
  }
    # SNP-Outcome Associations for those that are associated with primary indication and MR PREG outcomes, including direction of effect

  mr_preg_sig_results <- extract_mr_preg_sig_SNP(drug)

  # Present all significant SNP-outcome associations for those that are associated with primary indication and MR PREG outcomes, including direction of effect
  cat("\n\n## ", "Significant SNP-Outcome Associations", "\n\n", sep = "")

  final_sig_results_table <- sig_results_table(sig_results, mr_preg_sig_results)

  if(is.null(final_sig_results_table)){
  cat("No significant associations found for ", drug)
  next
  }

  cat("\n\n### ", "Instruments with Protective Effects on Indications", "\n\n", sep = "")

    protective_results_table <- final_sig_results_table %>%
        filter(Risk.x == "Decreased Risk")

  if(nrow(protective_results_table) == 0){
      cat("No protective effects found for", drug, "on indications")
  } else{
      cat("\n\n")
      cat(
        knitr::kable(
          protective_results_table %>%
            select(exposure, SNP, indication, originalname.outcome, Meaning, Risk.y),
          caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "Significant Associations") 
        )%>%
          kable_styling(font_size = 14), 
        sep = "\n")
      cat("\n\n")
  }

  # Plotting MR PREG results for instruments with a harmful effect on indications (those that increase risk of indication)
  
  cat("\n\n### ", "Harmful Instruments", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # Results for harmful instruments (those that increase risk of indication)

  harm_snps <- sig_results$harmonised_data %>%
      filter(Risk == "Increased Risk") %>%
      select(exposure, SNP)

  if(nrow(harm_snps) != 0){

    mr_preg_plot_df_harm <- mr_preg_plot_df$plot_df %>%
      semi_join(harm_snps, by = c("SNP", "id.exposure" = "exposure"))

    cat("\n\n", "Binary Outcomes", "\n\n", sep = "")

    # Binary Outcomes

    mr_preg_plot_df_harm_bin <- mr_preg_plot_df_harm %>% 
      filter(binary == "Yes")

    if(nrow(mr_preg_plot_df_harm_bin) == 0){

    cat("No significant binary MR PREG results found for ", drug)

    } else{
      for (g in mr_preg_plot_df$genes)  {

      p <- create_bin_plot(mr_preg_plot_df_harm_bin, g, mr_preg_plot_df$snps, mr_preg_plot_df$gene_cols)

      suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(print(p)))

      }
    }

    cat("\n\n", "Continuous Outcomes", "\n\n", sep = "")

    # Continuous Outcomes

    mr_preg_plot_df_harm_cont <- mr_preg_plot_df_harm %>% 
      filter(binary == "No")

    if(nrow(mr_preg_plot_df_harm_cont) == 0){

      cat("No significant continuous MR PREG results found for ", drug)
      
    } else{
      for (g in mr_preg_plot_df$genes)  {

      p <- create_cont_plot(mr_preg_plot_df_harm_cont, g, mr_preg_plot_df$snps, mr_preg_plot_df$gene_cols)

      suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(print(p)))

      }
    }
  }

  cat("\n\n## ", "Significant SNP-Outcome Associations", "\n\n", sep = "")

  cat("\n\n### ", "Instruments with Harmful Effects on Indications", "\n\n", sep = "")

  harmful_results_table <- final_sig_results_table %>%
      filter(Risk.x == "Increased Risk")

  if(nrow(harmful_results_table) == 0){
    cat("No harmful effects found for", drug, "on indications")
  } else{
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(knitr::kable(
        harmful_results_table %>%
          select(exposure, SNP, indication, originalname.outcome, Meaning, Risk.y),
        caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "Significant Associations"))%>%
          kable_styling(font_size = 14), 
        sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
